## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, please make sure you completed the following:

- [ ] My code targets the `staging` branch.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits spec](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] I ran `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm build` locally and they passed without errors.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console logs.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README if my changes introduce new features or change configuration requirements.
